packages.name: glib
packages.role: Foundation: types, strings, main loop, sources
packages.blurb: GLib 2.0 — fundamental types, main loop, file I/O, strings, hash tables, byte arrays.

packages.name: gobject
packages.role: The object system everything else builds on
packages.blurb: GObject 2.0 — type system, signals, properties, closures, the GValue / GParam machinery.

packages.name: gio
packages.blurb: Gio 2.0 — file, network, settings, app, dbus — the I/O and application platform on top of GLib.

packages.name: gdk_pixbuf
packages.blurb: GdkPixbuf 2.0 — image loading, pixel-buffer manipulation, PNG / JPEG / ICO / animated-GIF I/O.

packages.name: cairo
packages.blurb: cairo 1.0 — 2D vector graphics: paths, surfaces, gradients, transforms, the rendering engine GTK4 paints with.

packages.name: pango
packages.blurb: Pango 1.0 — text layout, fonts, shaping, and rendering. Bridges to Freetype / Fontconfig on the C side.

packages.name: gdk4
packages.blurb: Gdk 4 — display server abstraction, surfaces, input events, clipboard, drag-and-drop, cursors.

packages.name: graphene
packages.blurb: Graphene 1.0 — SIMD-friendly vector, matrix, and quaternion primitives for graphics math.

packages.name: gsk4
packages.blurb: Gsk 4 — the scene graph kit: render nodes, renderers, shaders, transforms, the layer between GTK4 and the GPU.

packages.name: gtk4
packages.blurb: Gtk 4 — the widget toolkit. Widgets, layout containers, dialogs, accessibility (GtkAccessible), templates (GtkBuildable).

packages.name: adw
packages.role: Application framework: header bars, toasts, styles
packages.blurb: Adw 1 — Libadwaita: adaptive widgets for GNOME applications (AdwApplicationWindow, AdwActionRow, AdwNavigationView, …).

packages.name: gtk_source5
packages.blurb: GtkSource 5 — source-code-aware text view: language specs, syntax highlighting, code folding, gutter renderers.

packages.name: gi_repository3
packages.blurb: GIR typelib loader — at-runtime GIR parsing for libraries that aren't statically bound.

packages.name: gir_ffi
packages.description: Hand-written runtime helpers — string marshalling, withNativeStringList, HeapAnchor
packages.blurb: Hand-written runtime helpers shared by every binding (withNativeString, withNativeStringList, HeapAnchor, g_free).

packages.name: gtk_templates
packages.description: Hand-written runtime — @GtkTemplate annotations, widget-class lookup, GBytes helpers
packages.blurb: Hand-written runtime for the composite-template stack: the @GtkTemplate annotations, widget-class lookup and template preparation.

packages.name: gtk_templates_builder
packages.description: Hand-written build_runner builder — scanner, codegen, CLI
packages.blurb: `build_runner` builder for the `@GtkTemplate` annotation pipeline (see also `gtk_templates`).
